svg.text: VP&C Agent Marketplace - Deployment architecture (Google Cloud)
Physical mapping of 01-logical-architecture. No public IP on any data or AI service; every hop below is authenticated and logged.
Google Cloud - Vodafone organisation (AI Booster landing zone)
Region europe-west4. CONFIRM against the Data Hub region and the Vodafone data residency standard.
BigQuery, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry and Logging are reachable only from inside. Blocks data egress even with valid credentials.
min 1 instance, ingress restricted to the
LB, no durable state on the instance
CMEK, day-partitioned with partition_expiration_days set per
The app reads views; it has no access to base tables
Who read which table, and when
Model access is brokered. The marketplace holds no model credential and no model endpoint.
Only the Concierge calls a model. The payload is the user's task description plus the public agent catalogue text. No supplier, contract,
purchase-order or spend data is in scope, so no such data can reach a model through this application.
Why there is no application-managed authentication
The browser only ever reaches the load balancer. IAP terminates the identity check before
any request reaches application code, so the marketplace has no login page, no password
store and no session cookie of its own. It reads the verified assertion header and trusts
Four controls a reviewer should check
1. Cloud Run cannot be reached except through the Serverless NEG.
2. BigQuery is reachable only from inside the perimeter, over Private Google Access.
3. A stolen service-account token is useless outside the perimeter.
4. Model access requires a credential the app holds only in Secret Manager, rotated by the
